edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller identity compared against owner/authority in isAuthorized
owner state variable is read to grant authorization
authority contract is queried through canCall to decide authorization
auth modifier gates setOwner on msg.sender and msg.sig
setOwnerByAdmin only checks msg.sender == admin, allowing central takeover
kill performs selfdestruct of the whole contract when owner calls
onlyOwner guards setAuthorized but ALL_AUTHORIZED bypasses per-user checks
write executes assembly create on caller supplied bytecode
local target address derived from CREATE is stored in cache mapping
block.timestamp (now) determines when monitor may be switched, timestamp dependency
tx.origin is consumed by getFee to decide automatic fee and mint state
getFee performs native value transfer to fixed wallet after external price/bot lookups
getGasCost transfers ETH after external oracle reads before state finalization
callProxy relies on ecrecover to authorize the proxy call
nonces mapping is read/written to prevent signature replay in callProxy
limitLoanAmount performs unchecked style arithmetic on debt and dust that feeds fee flows
givePermission calls DSGuard.permit granting execute rights to arbitrary contracts
botList mapping read from tx.origin to select fee tier, weak authorization source
subscribe stores holder under msg.sender used as identity
callExecute makes external DSProxy call and then transfers remaining balance back to msg.sender
onlyMonitor / allowed mapping gates callExecute but owner is always allowed
confirmNewMonitor swaps monitor state variable after timestamp deadline
withdrawStuckFunds is owner gated by msg.sender check
withdrawDai sends full DAI balance to msg.sender without any permission check
tx.origin influenced flows can trigger full balance drain via withdrawDai

normalization_plan.reason: New owner argument is only consumed by setOwner and should be folded into that function node
Admin address argument is passed into the admin management function and has no standalone identity
User argument only serves getFee fee-tier selection and wallet payout logic
Amount argument is scoped to the getFee computation and is transitory
Local fee result lives only inside getFee and is not observable elsewhere
Bytecode argument feeds the CREATE operation inside write only
Target address is produced and cached entirely within write
Gas amount argument is only used to compute cost in calcGasCost
Min ratio argument only drives parameter storage in subscribe
